verdict.rationale: GitBook documents site customization of the published docs' appearance, lists 'Advanced branding options' on its pricing page, and mentions custom blocks, which may cover your own components. Nothing in the pack shows custom CSS/JS injection or specific theme, font and layout controls, and one older community user called landing page customization limited. Missing for 10: documented custom CSS/JS support, specifics on theme/font/layout controls, clear documentation that custom blocks are user-built components, independent hands-on corroboration of branding depth.

support.subject: As a DevRel lead, I customize themes, fonts, and layout — down to custom CSS/JS or my own components — so the docs match my brand

citations.quote: You can customize the appearance of your published documentation, match the user interface to the language of your content, and more.
